summary: Build EVRVEST – Challenge Gravity as a premium, mobile-optimized cross-platform (web) performance training app for weighted-vest progressive overload, including onboarding, exercise catalog, plans, custom workouts, dashboard, AI coach chat, subscriptions, admin panel, brand styling, and specified mobile-readiness enhancements plus an exercise-screen dynamic load recommendation system.
architectural_notes: Target a mobile-optimized web app experience while retaining desktop/web functionality.
Client-side instant load recommendation calculations on exercise screen; no server dependency.
Use a shared Header component with safe-area inset top padding and per-route Back behavior.
Wrap routes with AnimatePresence to support slide transitions between screens.
Use optimistic UI updates for WorkoutBuilder and Admin mutations.
Support pull-to-refresh interactions on Dashboard and Exercise list views.
Avoid calling router.navigate() during render; perform redirects in effects/route guards so RouterProvider can mount and app never renders a blank screen during auth/onboarding redirects.
known_issues: Draft build shows a black screen on open, likely due to navigation/redirect logic running during render before RouterProvider mounts (redirect loop/return null).

existing_features.title: Implement Internet Identity authentication and a persistent user profile model that stores: bodyweightKg, heightCm, experienceLevel (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced/Elite), sportFocus, goals, weeklyTrainingFrequency, subscriptionTier (Free/Pro), annualDiscountEligible (boolean), and createdAt/updatedAt timestamps.

Build a smart onboarding flow that collects athlete profile fields and calculates an initial recommended vest load using the % bodyweight algorithm (Beginner 5–8%, Intermediate 8–12%, Advanced 10–15%, Elite up to 20% with warning), and save the chosen/confirmed recommendation to the user profile.

Create an exercise catalog with categories by sport (HYROX, Bodyweight, Running, Trail, Gym, Rehab). Each exercise must include: title, image placeholder, video placeholder, primary muscles, recommended load %, coaching cue, difficulty level, and the dynamic-load fields needed later (modeMultiplier, exerciseMultiplier, modeMinPct, modeMaxPct, explanationText). Provide filtering by experience level and sport.

Implement the Dynamic Load Recommendation System inside the Exercise Detail screen only, using existing user profile data and exercise multipliers: compute BaseLoad from bodyweightKg × experiencePercentage (Beginner 0.06, Intermediate 0.09, Advanced 0.12, Elite 0.15), compute RecRaw = BaseLoad × modeMultiplier × exerciseMultiplier, clamp to SafeMin/SafeMax derived from modeMinPct/modeMaxPct, round to nearest 0.5kg, and enforce a global cap of 20% bodyweight.

Add a “Load Recommendation Card” UI within Exercise Detail that shows: (1) large recommended load value, (2) safe range (SafeMin–SafeMax, rounded), (3) a color slider with green/yellow/red zones, (4) dynamic status text for green/yellow/red, and (5) an explanation section showing exercise.explanationText.

Create pre-built HYROX training plans in 4-week, 6-week, and 8-week variants that include SkiErg intervals, lunges, row intervals, burpees, treadmill incline, and stairmaster progression; include weekly progression logic with vest load increase, include a deload week, and collect RPE feedback after workouts to adjust future load recommendations within the plan.

Implement a custom Workout Builder that allows users to select exercises, define sets/reps/rest, choose vest load, calculate session load volume and an intensity score, and save workout templates for reuse.

Create a performance dashboard showing: weekly load volume, average vest % bodyweight, workout frequency, elevation meters, stability score, and progress graphs; include pull-to-refresh behavior on mobile for dashboard data.

Implement an AI Coach chat screen named “GravityAI” that provides load recommendations, plan creation guidance, recovery advice, exercise technique help, and product education using an on-device/rule-based knowledge system (no external LLM calls), with a direct, athletic, performance-focused tone.

Implement subscription tiers and feature gating: Free tier includes load calculator and limited exercises; Pro tier unlocks full plans, GravityAI, and dashboard analytics; annual Pro subscribers have annualDiscountEligible = true in their profile. Provide UI for viewing tier status and upgrading (without requiring external payment integration).

Create an Admin Panel restricted to admin principals that can: add/edit exercises (including dynamic-load fields), add/edit plans, add monthly challenges, and manage subscription tiers (e.g., set users to Pro/Annual).

Apply EVRVEST brand identity across the entire app UI: dark mode default, black dominant backgrounds, deep performance blue as primary accent for active states/buttons/highlights/progress indicators/recommended load emphasis, white typography, strong bold headlines, minimalist sharp aesthetic (no gradients, no playful rounding, no unnecessary shadows), and optionally include brand messages subtly in UI copy.

Implement mobile-readiness enhancements while keeping web functionality: add account deletion to Profile; set global CSS overscroll-behavior: none and user-select: none (except for text content); use a shared Header component that shows a Back button on Profile and Admin Panel; wrap route transitions in AnimatePresence with slide transitions; apply safe-area-inset-top for header padding; add pull-to-refresh to Dashboard and Exercise lists.

Add optimistic UI updates (React Query) for mutations in Workout Builder (saving/updating templates and logged workouts) and Admin panel (CRUD operations), including rollback on error and user-visible error messaging.
Implement bottom-tab navigation for primary app sections (e.g., Dashboard, Exercises, Plans, Builder, Profile), ensuring a clean mobile-first layout and keeping desktop web usability.

Fix the black-screen-on-open issue by removing all imperative navigation calls from the AppContent render path in frontend/src/App.tsx and ensuring the app always renders a visible UI state (RouterProvider or a loading/auth screen) while auth/profile state is being resolved.

Implement route-level guarding/redirect behavior using TanStack Router mechanisms (e.g., route beforeLoad/loader redirection or equivalent) so that authentication and onboarding redirects happen within the router lifecycle rather than from AppContent render logic.

Add a safe fallback UI for unexpected routing/auth errors so the app never displays an empty screen; the fallback must be visually consistent with the existing EVRVEST dark theme and use clear English user-facing text.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement smart onboarding flow capturing athlete profile data and calculating initial recommended vest load by experience % bodyweight with warnings; store in user profile.
Create exercise catalog categorized by sport with exercise detail fields (image/video placeholders, muscles, recommended load %, cues, difficulty) and filters by level and sport.
Add pre-built HYROX training plans (4/6/8-week) with required workouts, weekly progression, deload week, and RPE feedback to adjust load.
Build custom Workout Builder: select exercises, configure sets/reps/rest/load, compute session load volume + intensity score, and save templates.
Create performance dashboard with weekly load volume, avg vest % BW, workout frequency, elevation meters, stability score, and progress graphs.
Implement AI Coach chat (“GravityAI”) for load recommendations, plan creation, recovery advice, technique, and product education with direct athletic tone.
Add subscription model: Free tier (load calculator + limited exercises) and Pro tier (€5/mo or €49/yr) unlocking plans, AI coach, analytics; annual subscribers get 10% shop discount flag in profile.
Create admin panel to manage exercises, plans, monthly challenges, and subscription tiers.
Apply EVRVEST brand identity across the app (dark mode default, black dominant UI, deep performance blue accents, strong typography, minimalist sharp aesthetic, brand messages).

Mobile readiness updates while keeping web functionality: account deletion on Profile; global CSS overscroll-behavior none + user-select none (except text); shared Header with Back button on Profile/Admin; AnimatePresence slide transitions; safe-area-inset-top header padding; optimistic updates for WorkoutBuilder/Admin mutations; pull-to-refresh on Dashboard and Exercise lists.

Add Dynamic Load Recommendation System inside existing Exercise Detail screen using user profile bodyweight/experience plus exercise multipliers & safe caps, including load zones UI card and auto-recalculation.

Implement core backend data persistence and APIs in a single Motoko actor to support: user profiles, exercises, plans, challenges, workout templates, workout logs (including RPE), and admin-managed subscription status; ensure per-user scoping and admin authorization checks.
